reviews.review: If you are interested in this game check out the [url=http://lnotepad.blogspot.co.il/2014/01/the-grand-dawn-of-war-video-project.html] Grand Dawn of War Video Project[/url].

If you're a fan of Warhammer 40k, this is a must-have, even though it's not a RPG game. 

The story is not much to say but what so special about this game is the 40k's immersion/feeling. 10/10
The gameplay is pretty good, satisfy fighting/shooting... 7/10

Highly recommended for Warhammer fans.

This a 3D shooter in which your avatar (a 3 meter tall superhuman wrapped in baby blue battle armor)  wades through a broken, post-apocalyptic landscape, using a selection of unlikely, anachronistic  gadgets to dissolve hordes of near mindless enemies into piles of gore and clouds of splattered blood.  If that description alone is not enough to make your heart beat a little faster and your palms a little sweaty, you are probably browsing the wrong section of the Steam store.

Seriously though, this is a game well worth buying (when it is on sale, anyway).  The gameplay is fairly solid.  The mechanics are entertaining.  And the single-player storyline is actually about as good as gets for a video game, let alone a 3D shooter.  In a genre filled with over-the-top action heroes, pseudo-military jargon spewers and gangster wannabees, Captain Titus, is a genuinely decent , believable hero-type.  Its a nice change of pace.  And the dialogue and voice acting for all the human characters is outstanding.  They really come to life.  

I have several much lengthier, deranged rants about playing this game on my blog, accessible from my profile page.

Recommended for any fan of warhammer 40 k out here. Solid gameplay and cool campaign although a bit short. Graphics are still ok. The multiplayer is good but unfortunately there's no dedicated servers and finding a game is sometimes difficult. 7.5/10

As a fan of the Warhammer Universe, this game was brutally amazing. The story and acting was as entertaining as it was epic, even if the gameplay is as simple as it gets, it still got me to play this game throughout the campaign and not get bored.

The online mode itself is amazing in its own way, customizing your Space Marine or Chaos Marine armor and weapons makes the multiplayer so fun, i absolutly loved the Exterminatus Mode after finishing the campaign.

Trully love this game, both the campaign and multiplayer are fantastic in my opinion, Relic did an amazing job with Warhammer Space Marine.
